sentences.en: A hypothetical explanation could be that they just forgot it.
sentences.zh: 一个假设性的解释可能是他们只是忘记了。

sentences.en: You grew up without learning about interesting hypothetical scenarios.
sentences.zh: 你成长的过程中没有接触到有趣的假设性情境。

sentences.en: When will the most probable hypothetical accident occur?
sentences.zh: 最有可能的假设性事故什么时候会发生？
